ratings_why.fun: The lead queue and the death handoff are a real puzzle, but Tiers 1-3 are mostly silent bodies and the recruit turn needs a lot of Front swapping.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7: one rule silences every Lemming but the Front, so reading order becomes a queue of leaders and each recruit action picks its own speaker; no tribe today plays like that.

verdict_why: The core rule reads cleanly, but Herding Council, Old Mother Lemen and doubled swaps leave real rules questions a player can't answer from the cards.

points.text: With two Fronts, say whether both carry the Banner and whether Gerd, Cantor and Pilgrim count both; as written a player can't tell.
The Front Lemming doubling Trailbreaker means two swaps, which puts Trailbreaker back in front; say that a doubled swap happens only once.
Old Mother Lemen: say whether Kits copy her printed body or her body plus the Banner; the build says plus the Banner, the card doesn't.

The seed is the many over the one, but the board shows one voice and six blanks; one or two low-tier cards that react from behind (when your Front takes the lead) would let the herd feel present early.
Make Tally a non-Lemming whose text always works: the fox counting the herd reads better, and it shows the rule by contrast.

standouts.why: Next-Cliff Pilgrim reads at a glance and is the cliff cult in one line: it falls so the Banner goes further.
Gerd the Shouter draws every attack onto the leader, which is the lemming staring down the owl, and it sets the order the queue dies in.
The Front Lemming is a clear Brann-style multiplier for the tribe's one trigger, and the title fits: it hands the front on.

weakest.why: Kit-Minder only speaks at End of Turn as the Front, where it competes with Banner-Bearer and works against Lemen.
Ole fills slots ahead of your Front with blank Kits, so the easy play silences your opener.
A fox tagged Lemming muddles the one rule the tribe asks players to learn.

flags.note: Two Fronts versus the Banner, Gerd's targeting and Cantor's trigger are undefined.
A doubled Trailbreaker swaps twice and lands back in front.
Whether the Kits copy the Banner on top of her body isn't stated.
Golden Brother Onward after Cantor and The Front Lemming gives twice a large Banner to everyone, twice.
